note: SWIFT's IBAN Registry, the column for Norway, as the copy gives it. Its BBAN structure is written "NO4!n6!n1!n"; the structure is read from its IBAN structure ("NO2!n4!n6!n1!n"). A national check inside the BBAN, where the country has one, isn't in the registry and isn't modelled: a number drawn here passes the IBAN's own check. Release 103 (September 2026) is SWIFT's current; changes since this copy aren't read.

sources.title: SWIFT, IBAN Registry (ISO 13616), its text release: the copy in GNU Taler's iban-tools (registry.txt, commit 81b6dbcb, 2025-02-18; its latest country update December 2024), read there because swift.com answered every request with HTTP 403 on 2026-10-30
